notes.title: Arcade Mode, Dressing Mode, Demo update, Translation etc...
notes.content:
Hi how's everyone doing? Omshinwa here, here's an update that I planned to do for a while.

The additions are gameplay related. First in the casino, There's two new additions, [b]DRESSING ROOM[/b], and [b]ARCADE MODE[/b] (the roguelike mode). 

Previously you needed to complete 3 achievements to unlock 1 new card in the casino, now you only need 1 achievement, so people that already had at least 5 achievement can just launch the game and try the Arcade mode immediately.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917015/237f3371b7e3343445918792ef370120c9582499.png[/img]

[h1]Arcade Roguelike Mode[/h1]

It's a challenging infinite mode where you can try and make Joyce orgasms as many times as you can. Inspired by roguelike deckbuilding games (like say Slay the Spire), you start with a new default deck, you can go to shops to try to improve your deck, or your stamina, or even increase your Drink maximum number of shuffle (in Arcade mode, it starts at 1). There's no end and no real reward besides having fun! My high score is like around 30, if you manage to go past round 30 you're really good at the game lol.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917015/bf59f6bed65d77f97bd07967b44e7221bc55919a.png[/img]
[i]Between rounds you can improve your deck[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917015/2633c64539b068855c28b4949314a7b671a04509.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917015/bc81025d899f08db45cc21e5fa7436ca7bbb94b6.png[/img]
[i]You basically keep going until you lose the game[/i]

[h1]Dressing Mode[/h1]

In dressing mode, you get to dress, checks all the outfits and see Joyce's expressions that are featured in the story.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917015/c464b5884ae877b9c380c504e7ddb0b93c8ed55c.png[/img]

Do note that some combinaison maybe look buggy, that's because I haven't exactly drawn every combinaison together (they don't appear in the story) lol.

When you exit the Dressing Mode, Joyce in the casino will stay in that outfit and that pose.

[h2]Change language[/h2]

Might not interest as many people, but [b]the game now supports French[/b]. It's the only language added yet, I have plans of adding Russian (with the help of  wolvovic, thanks to them). I'd also like to translate it to [b]Japanese, if anyone has experience in translating English to Japanese[/b] (or know someone else that can), please contact me lol.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917015/b106f18477efd07d2f8c8e31ad15199688f05204.png[/img]

You can change languages either in the casino by playing the 'Change language' card, or in the pause menu, though if you're in an old save you might run into some bug if you do that.

While I'm at it, if anyone has some Voice Actress suggestion to voice Joyce, I'm willing to look lol.

[h2]Small changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] The Replay mode in Memories now has images for each memory (before it was just a text with "missionary", now there's pictures).
[*] I've been redrawing some BGs a bit, the AI ones mostly (I have used AI on some backgrounds). Hopefully I can redraw them totally until you can't see the AI anymore.
[*] Origin of the World works faster if you have huge numbers. Before if your [b]Stamina reached numbers like 457000[/b] (someone did...) it would take a long time to play out. I have also updated the UI in that regard (before if you went past 2500, the numbers would go offset...) The dick size also scales better the bigger your Lust. 
[*] The [b]demo[/b] has been rebuilt based on the latest version, so now saves should be compatible (also demo has the new features like multiple languages etc...)
[*] And probably tooons of small bugs that have been corrected (One that comes to mind is when you used to do Universe Out, it would use the zoom level you use to look at your deck...)
[/list]

[h2]Card balance[/h2]

Some changes in card effects:

[b]Slow Down now slows very much.[/b] It used to slow down by only 1 speed, now it slows by 2 speeds. Slow Down I feel like isn't too good in Act 3+. Maybe now it's too strong for Act 2? Tell me what you think.

[b]Dark Hole now draws EVERY "Space Out" in the deck and in the discard pile.[/b] Okay this one may be a bit crazy lol. Before it drew max 3 cards, but I feel like Space decks are pretty fun to play but they scale pretty badly, so now you can go crazy and have as many Space Out in your deck.

Thanks for everyone that bought the game so far, I hope you enjoy this update. I also hope I didn't break anything, please report me any bug you find! PEACE.

>so i had to change the puzzle 4 for something else (kinda looks like puzzle 1 tbh)
>a few changes like Joyce gives you your first Drink card instead of your cat (and you get more Drink cards with dream joyce, not through the cat). same for some other trivial dialogues
>added "big brain" achievement (you have to solve all 4 rat puzzles)
>Load + Contact cards at the casino
>maybe Mac TTS works now..?

hopefully i didnt break anything while doing that!
